player_prompt.intro:
Tqadret ad tesleḍ leḥsab n Sokoban. D kečč, yessefk ad tessexleḍ akk ixefren ɣer timselɣa.
        Mi d-kečč tesɛaḍeɛ ɣef uɣbalu, tzemreḍ ad tessexleḍ-it s tsebbelt nni.
        Ur tzemreḍ ara ad tessexleḍ ixefren s yegrawen, u ur tzemreḍ ara ad ternuḍ ixefren.
        Ɣef uḍebsi, imuren ttbanen-d: 
        - Kečč (d kečč) itban-d s 'P' 
        - Yegrawen ttbanen-d s '#' 
        - Ixefren ttbanen-d s 'X' 
        - Timselɣa tuffiɣen-d s 'O'
        - Ixefren ɣef timselɣa ttbanen-d s '√'
        Tzemreḍ daɣen ad tesqedceḍ [w] i lfuṛ, [a] i tazleɣt, [s] i lqedd, u [d] i tamaṭṭ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tameɣra i d-ttuneft akken ma ilaq. Seqdec [up], [down], [left], [right] neɣ [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Taḥeblem-a ur d tin n lεali.
invalid_move.wall_collision: Ur tezmireḍ ara ad tgerzeḍ ɣer lḥiḍ!
invalid_move.invalid_position: Aḥeddad ur nlaq ara - Ur yezmir ad yeddu ɣer umkan-nni.

game_message.pushed_prefix: Iḥewwes yiwen n usenduq mi yella d-yettwaɣ.

outcome.turn_limit: Tewweḍ-d tezmert n usegmi. Ur d-tefruḍ ara timcewwekt-nni.
